input.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/lab_runs
run() {
  local tag="$1"; shift
  ./bin/lab train "$@" --json 2>&1
}
N=1e8; D=2e9
declare -a mixes=(
  '{"web":0.4,"code":0.2,"math":0.2,"papers":0.2}'
  '{"web":0.25,"code":0.25,"math":0.25,"papers":0.25}'
  '{"web":0.1,"code":0.3,"math":0.3,"papers":0.3}'
  '{"web":0.9,"code":0.033,"math":0.033,"papers":0.034}'
  '{"web":0.5,"code":0.4,"math":0.05,"papers":0.05}'
  '{"web":0.5,"code":0.05,"math":0.4,"papers":0.05}'
  '{"web":0.5,"code":0.05,"math":0.05,"papers":0.4}'
  '{"web":0.6,"code":0.2,"math":0.1,"papers":0.1}'
  '{"web":0.6,"code":0.1,"math":0.2,"papers":0.1}'
  '{"web":0.6,"code":0.1,"math":0.1,"papers":0.2}'
  '{"web":0.3,"code":0.3,"math":0.2,"papers":0.2}'
)
out=/tmp/lab_runs/mixsweep1.jsonl
> "$out"
for m in "${mixes[@]}"; do
  ./bin/lab train N=$N D=$D --json "{\"mix\": $m}" | tr -d '\n' >> "$out"
  echo "  MIX=$m" >> "$out"
done
cat "$out"
